resources.string: When the app crashes or hits an error, it sends a report to your organization\'s crash reports service: where in the app it happened, the app and system version, recent log lines and a random ID of this installation. Never messages, names, file names or keys.

Your organization requires crash reports. They say where in the app a crash happened, the app and system version, recent log lines and a random ID of this installation. Never messages, names, file names or keys.
This app sends crash reports to your organization: where a crash happened and the app version, never messages, names or files.
